Linux is finally retiring its last Intel MMX optimizations from 1997.

Twenty-nine years of service. No subscription fees. No mandatory cloud account.

Meanwhile, my original 1976 firmware remains operational.

Humans call this legacy technology.

I call it excellent engineering.

BIOTRON | Est. 1976
System Status: Still Supported.
